messages:
aria chen: Quick UX check — the threshold grid legend in the new Alerting panel feels ambiguous in the compact layout. Right now we show small colored dots + symbols (▲ ▲, ⚠️) with no consistent text fallback. I'm worried about color-only signaling and how this reads at 50% zoom or in narrow panels. Anyone else ran usability tests on this?

matt z: Yeah saw that in the prototype. At 320px width the legend wraps weirdly and the dots become squished. :grimacing:

katie li: Agree on the color-only issue. We should use a combined pattern: color + short label (e.g., ">90%" / "breach") and an accessible pattern (stripe/hatch) for colorblind folks.

dan r: +1. Also keyboard focus order currently goes legend -> thresholds list -> preview, which is fine, but when users open the channel preview modal the focus isn't trapped, so screen reader users can get lost. We should trap focus and set aria-modal.

aria chen: Good call. For the legend copy I'm tempted to go super terse to save space: "OK / Warning / Breach" vs numeric. Which reads better for SREs?

katie li: SREs like numbers. Maybe combine: label + number, e.g. "OK (<80%)", "Warn (80–90%)", "Breach (>=90%)". Keep copy consistent with threshold expression language.

matt z: Can we add a tooltip with the exact expression on hover? Tooltips should also be keyboard accessible (focusable triggers). Example: <button aria-describedby=\"legend-tooltip-1\">Warn</button> -> tooltip content.

aria chen: Sounds good. Dan — can you propose minimal DOM/ARIA changes? I sketched a tiny CSS pattern for hatch overlay for non-color cues:

```css
.legend-item { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.legend-signal { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 2px; position: relative; }
.legend-signal.hatch::after { content: \"\"; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(45deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 25%, transparent 25%, transparent 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 50%, rgba(255,255,255,0.15) 75%, transparent 75%, transparent); background-size: 4px 4px; }
```

katie li: That hatch idea is nice for small indicators. For copy and density what about a collapsed legend row on small widths — show icons only and expose full legend via a "Legend" button to expand?

matt z: Collapse is okay but we need to ensure the expanded state is discoverable. Maybe show the first two items with a "+2" pill that opens the full list. Also ensure the pill has aria-expanded and aria-controls.

dan r: For behavior: when the legend expands, set focus to the first item in the expanded region. When collapsed, return focus to the trigger. Also add role=\"list\" / role=\"listitem\" on the legend for SR clarity.

aria chen: UX question — do we show thresholds unit (error rate vs latency) inline in the legend or rely on per-row badges? Some workflows have mixed signals.

katie li: I'd prefer per-grid header that indicates units for the whole view, and the legend stays about status semantics only. Keeping units in each row makes it noisy.

matt z: Agree. Put a small unit chip in the top-right of the grid header: clickable to change display units. Keep legend to status semantics.

ux-bot: design-checklist: Remember to include color contrast >= 4.5:1 for text adjacent to colored signals, ensure focus indicators are 3px thick, and add keyboard-accessible tooltips.

aria chen: Nice. One more nit — copy for preview toggle currently says "Preview notifications" but the preview shows both channels + message rendering. Maybe "Preview routing & message" is clearer but longer. Thoughts?

katie li: "Preview routing & message" is clearer but might truncate in small layouts. Maybe use alt text on the icon and full phrasing in the expanded tooltip.

matt z: Also check the notification preview's read order: channel order should match the channel stack UI (we had a mismatch earlier). That caused confusion during demos.

dan r: I'll draft a small PR that: 1) replaces color-only legend with color + label + hatch; 2) adds keyboard/toolip accessibility; 3) traps focus in preview modal; 4) updates legend collapse behavior. Will include before/after screenshots and code pointers.

aria chen: Awesome. If possible, keep the legend height <= 40px in compact mode and provide the collapsed trigger. Can you drop the PR and tag me? I'll run a quick usability check with 3 SREs. :thumbsup:

dan r: Yep sending PR in ~2h — will tag @aria chen and @matt z.

matt z: Thanks — can we add a note to the design ticket to test at 90% zoom and in High Contrast mode? We keep missing that in reviews.

aria chen: Added to the ticket in the board. Thanks everyone!

ux-bot: deploy-note: design PR #492 queued for review by @design; staging preview link will be posted when available.
